lines.text: Ben wore jeans on a cool fall hike.
A light drizzle soaked them, and the cotton stayed cold and heavy for hours.
Here's what to wear hiking instead.
Pick pants made of quick-drying synthetic fabric like nylon, with some stretch for big steps.
Leggings work on dry days, convertible pants when it warms up. Skip cotton.
Now Ben's pants shed the drizzle and dry while he walks.
For real rain, add a rain shell.
Save this before your next hike.
